scope: Fresh constructive planar-Bell scout. Primary passages only; broad search results and old project bibliographies do not establish priority.

sources.title: All Incompatible Measurements on Qubits Lead to Multiparticle Bell Nonlocality
sources.authors: Martin Plavala; Otfried Guhne; Marco Tulio Quintino
sources.depth: Author HTML main theorem, proof framework, trine example, final open questions explicitly naming GHZ/Dicke families and party count. Publisher metadata and abstract checked.
sources.boundary: Broad existence theorem inherited. We only construct the unbiased binary coplanar subclass. No independent proof of the paper’s general positive-map result.

sources.title: Joint measurability of coplanar POVMs
sources.authors: Taro Yoshino; Koichi Tojo; Kei Hagihara; Akinori Tanaka; Takuki Tomita
sources.depth: Primary indexed abstract only; exact planar perimeter criterion announced. Direct full-text routes inaccessible.
sources.boundary: No claim of new compatibility geometry. Its complete discussion may cover the proposed Bell consequence. No novelty clearance from inaccessible text. We supply our own centrally symmetric convention and proof.

sources.title: Measurement Incompatibility versus Bell Nonlocality: An Approach via Tensor Norms
sources.depth: Author v2 parsed introduction and Section2 main definitions and bounds; bipartite fixed-Alice setting and compatibility tensor-norm normalization.
sources.boundary: Tensor-norm view is inherited. No complete audit of all cited generalizations or proof that no tensor-norm corollary covers the new construction.

sources.title: Symmetric multipartite Bell inequalities via Frank-Wolfe algorithms
sources.authors: Sebastien Designolle; Tamas Vertesi; Sebastian Pokutta
sources.depth: Primary PDF model, Eqs.(6)-(8), regular-polygon GHZ setting, overview and conclusion; author abstract and publication metadata.
sources.boundary: Regular-polygon GHZ witnesses are established and used as controls, not claimed original. No figure/table numeric values imported or claim of better finite-N noise thresholds.

sources.title: Joint measurability structures realizable with qubit measurements: Incompatibility via marginal surgery
sources.depth: Definitions and SectionII compatibility overview, two- and three-observable conditions, equal-purity/coplanar qualifications.
sources.boundary: No new claim for pairwise-compatible globally-incompatible measurements. No whole-paper proof recreation.

sources.title: Measurement incompatibility does not give rise to Bell violation in general
sources.publication: New Journal of Physics20,013021(2018); author PDF rendered date14June2021
sources.depth: Primary PDF introduction, setup and conclusion.
sources.boundary: Used to distinguish pairwise joint measurability from full-family bipartite locality. No all-state bipartite-local claim for our irregular example.
